servers.description: List of DHCP server IP addresses (or hostnames) to which client requests will be relayed. At least one server is required.

items.description: IP address or resolvable hostname of a DHCP server

interfaces.description: List of network interfaces on which the relay agent listens for incoming DHCP DISCOVER/OFFER/REQUEST messages. At least one interface is required.

options.description: Additional command-line options to pass to dhcrelay. Use sparingly—prefer structured settings when possible. Examples: ['--no-pid'] or ['-i'] to enableOption 82 (Remote ID/Link selection).

items.description: Single dhcrelay(8) command-line option or flag
